policy: Official and reliable source backlog for candidate ingestion. Entries are not public data. They feed source checks and human review only.

tiers.name: Official disease, prevention, and case definition pages
Peer-reviewed public-health literature and agency reports
News, search, and social discovery signals

sources.title: CDC NNDSS Weekly Data Socrata endpoint
sources.publisher: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
sources.candidateUse: Internal weekly review candidates for HPS and non-HPS hantavirus rows.
sources.reviewNeed: Requires NNDSS weekly display rule before public display. Do not show geocode or treat as live/local/final counts.

sources.title: WHO Disease Outbreak News index
sources.candidateUse: Discovery of official hantavirus DON items.
sources.reviewNeed: Extracted DON links require event-specific human review before any public alert update.

sources.title: PAHO documents index
sources.candidateUse: Discovery of PAHO epidemiological alerts and regional updates.
sources.reviewNeed: Only official hantavirus-specific documents should be promoted after review.

sources.title: PAHO news index
sources.candidateUse: Discovery of official PAHO hantavirus response updates.
sources.reviewNeed: News items are official only when published by PAHO; still require event-specific limitations.

sources.title: ECDC publications and data index
sources.publisher: European Centre for Disease Prevention and Control
sources.candidateUse: Discovery of ECDC annual reports, rapid assessments, and disease updates.
sources.reviewNeed: Each result must be reviewed for syndrome/geography differences before public use.
